description: Distretti di Protezione civile is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Agenzia per l'Italia Digitale. Municipalities are invited to "associate" in Civil Protection Districts, in order to better share knowledge, control and interventions on the territory. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "Civil Protection Districts" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include disaster relief, crisis management, rescue system, open data, disaster preparedness, environmental contingency planning. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support emergency planning and critical-facility studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
